description: Continue FF-output unions after a fully qualifying capped band
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,566 parameters at 99.020000%, a +0.020000-point margin. There have been 67 prior macro-attempts and 573 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0169/micro-0020 at 1,566/99.02%; the most recent failed result remains attempt-0168/micro-0005, where FF-output pair 183/223 scored 98.99% at 1,585, because attempt 169 had no failures. Four measured sensitive FF-output pairs remain excluded. Hypothesis: the fully qualifying 20-trial band ended only at its hard cap, so the next minimum-difference unions should be tested under a new bounded macro rather than treating the administrative cap as a scientific boundary. The helper adds one ordered union per official micro-trial with runner-only retention/rollback. Stop at first scored discard/error, no pair, 20 trials, or 25 minutes. This is more informative than switching tensors because the immediately preceding policy had 100% yield.
summary: The FF-output continuation evaluated 15 ordered unions. Fourteen qualified and reduced the frontier from 1,566 to 1,552 parameters; micro-0015 proposed 1,551, failed qualification, and was rolled back. Outcomes: 14 accepts, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors. Compute used 15 official migrations/verifications over about 18m30s. Stop reason: first scored discard before the 20-trial/25-minute cap.
